text.relics:TUNGSTEN_ROD.description: Whenever you would lose HP, lose {HpLossReduction} less.
text.relics:TUNGSTEN_ROD.title: Tungsten Rod
text.relics:TUNING_FORK.description: Every time you play {Cards} Skills, gain {Block} Block.
text.relics:TUNING_FORK.title: Tuning Fork
text.relics:TWISTED_FUNNEL.description: At the start of each combat, apply {PoisonPower} Poison to ALL enemies.
text.relics:TWISTED_FUNNEL.title: Twisted Funnel
text.relics:UNCEASING_TOP.description: Whenever you have no cards in Hand during your turn, draw a card.
text.relics:UNCEASING_TOP.title: Unceasing Top
text.relics:UNDYING_SIGIL.description: Enemies with at least as much Doom as HP deal 50% less damage.
text.relics:UNDYING_SIGIL.title: Undying Sigil
text.relics:UNSETTLING_LAMP.description: Each combat, the first time you play a card that Debuffs an enemy, double its effect.
text.relics:UNSETTLING_LAMP.title: Unsettling Lamp
text.relics:VAJRA.title: Vajra
text.relics:VAMBRACE.description: The first time you gain Block from a card each combat, double the amount gained.
text.relics:VAMBRACE.title: Vambrace
text.relics:VELVET_CHOKER.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. You cannot play more than {Cards} {Cards:plural:card|cards} per turn.
text.relics:VELVET_CHOKER.title: Velvet Choker
text.relics:VENERABLE_TEA_SET.description: Whenever you enter a Rest Site, start the next combat with an additional {Energy:energyIcons()}.
text.relics:VENERABLE_TEA_SET.title: Venerable Tea Set
text.relics:VERY_HOT_COCOA.description: Start each combat with an additional {Energy:energyIcons()}.
text.relics:VERY_HOT_COCOA.title: Very Hot Cocoa
text.relics:VEXING_PUZZLEBOX.description: At the start of each combat, add a random card into your Hand. It's free to play this turn.
text.relics:VEXING_PUZZLEBOX.title: Vexing Puzzlebox
text.relics:VINE_BRACELET.description: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by {MaxHp}.
text.relics:VINE_BRACELET.title: Vine Bracelet
text.relics:VITRUVIAN_MINION.description: Cards containing “Minion” deal double damage and gain double Block.
text.relics:VITRUVIAN_MINION.title: Vitruvian Minion
text.relics:WAR_HAMMER.description: Whenever you kill an Elite, Upgrade {Cards} random {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
text.relics:WAR_HAMMER.title: War Hammer
text.relics:WAR_PAINT.title: War Paint
text.relics:WHETSTONE.title: Whetstone
text.relics:WHISPERING_EARRING.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. Vakuu plays your first turn for you.
text.relics:WHISPERING_EARRING.title: Whispering Earring
text.relics:WHITE_BEAST_STATUE.description: Potions always appear in combat rewards.
text.relics:WHITE_BEAST_STATUE.title: White Beast Statue
text.relics:WHITE_STAR.description: Elites drop an additional Rare card reward.
text.relics:WHITE_STAR.title: White Star
text.relics:WINGED_BOOTS.description: You may ignore paths when choosing the next rooms to travel to {Rooms} times.
text.relics:WINGED_BOOTS.title: Winged Boots
text.relics:WING_CHARM.description: A random card in each card reward is Enchanted with Swift {SwiftAmount}.
text.relics:WING_CHARM.title: Wing Charm
text.relics:WONGOS_MYSTERY_TICKET.title: Wongo's Mystery Ticket
text.relics:YUMMY_COOKIE.title: Yummy Cookie
